text:
incident-bot: P1 alert: sudden spike in 502/504 from api-gateway layer. error_rate > 12% over 2m. Affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate. Dash: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/edge/gateway-502-spike :rotating_light:
sara_oncall: ack I'm on. looking at edge dashboards and traces. spike started ~02:08 UTC, saw simultaneous increases across us-west and eu-central.
ron_proxy: Im tailing envoy on edge-proxy-usw-*. lots of `TLS handshake failed` and `upstream response timeout` in the logs. Handshake failures correlate with long-lived upstream connections being closed.
priya_infra: infra metrics: nodes healthy, no CPU/mem saturation. Not seeing backend pod OOMs. However, keepalive conn drops on model-backend pool at the same timestamps. p95 backend latency up from 180ms -> 800ms.
deploy-bot: Recent event: cert-rotation-service applied new edge certs at 02:05 UTC (job cert-rot-2025-06-12). No route config changes.
ron_proxy: Huh, could be TLS session ticket/cipher incompatibility with our mTLS config + envoy upgrade. Searching for recent envoy flags.
sara_oncall: Can we try routing a fraction of traffic to an isolated pool (standby-inference) to see if errors persist?
priya_infra: Spinning up standby pool now and priming model containers. `kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-backend-standby --replicas=4` launching.
traffic-bot: Traffic action: adding 5% weight to standby-inference via routing policy.
ron_proxy: After diverting ~5% traffic, error rate on that subset is ~0.8% (baseline). Main pool still at ~13%. This points to upstream pool issue.
priya_infra: Dumping keepalive settings and socket stats. Seeing many TIME_WAIT and FIN_WAIT2 for connections between envoy and backend. Possible mismatch in keepalive timeouts.
sara_oncall: Any chance of a bad cert chain causing renegotiation floods?
deploy-bot: cert-rotation job logs: `kubectl logs job/cert-rot-2025-06-12` shows rotation completed successfully at 02:05; rotation target was edge cert only, not backend. No backend cert changes recorded.
ron_proxy: Trying quick mitigation: bump envoy upstream idle timeout and enable connection re-use. Patching envoy config on the fleets. Applying to a canary subset first.
ron_proxy: ```
# canary patch
kubectl -n edge patch deploy edge-proxy-canary --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"envoy","env":[{"name":"UPSTREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"60000"},{"name":"HTTP_KEEPALIVE","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```
priya_infra: Also increasing net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on edge nodes as a precaution: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=350000` and clearing old conntrack entries `sudo conntrack -F`.
ron_proxy: Canary results: canary edge-proxies show error rate drop from 12% -> 1.2% for traffic routed through them. Main fleet still high. Rolling patch to rest of fleet.
sara_oncall: Great. While you roll, can we also add short-term retry-on-5xx with backoff on the edge for the vulnerable routes to reduce customer errors? keep it conservative.
ron_proxy: Adding retry policy for /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate: 1 retry with 200ms jitter. Pushing config now.
ron_proxy: ```
# envoy retry snippet
filters:
  - name: envoy.filters.http.router
    typed_config:
      "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.router.v3.Router
      retry_policy:
        retry_on: "5xx,gateway-error"
        num_retries: 1
        per_try_timeout: 3s
```
incident-bot: Metric update (02:17 UTC): cluster-wide error_rate decreased from 12.6% -> 3.4% after fleet patch & retries. p50 latency trending down. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
priya_infra: Scaling note: increased replicas on model-backend pool from 3 -> 8 to absorb request bursts while connections settle. `kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-backend --replicas=8`.
jess_cs: Drafting status page blurb: "We are investigating increased 5xx responses for some API traffic. We have applied routing & proxy mitigations and scaled backend capacity; users may have seen errors between ~02:08-02:18 UTC. Monitoring continues." will post in 5.
sara_oncall: Any persistent errors in traces pointing to TLS mismatch? Ron?
ron_proxy: After patching idle timeouts and reusing connections, TLS handshake failure messages dropped dramatically. Hypothesis: cert rotation caused a brief spike in session invalidation coinciding with higher than normal connection churn; combined with shorter idle timeout (from an earlier tuning) caused frequent connection re-establishment and some racey handshakes leading to upstream timeouts. Mitigation = increase keepalive/idle timeouts + retries + scale + conntrack bump.
priya_infra: I also bumped the backend L4 proxy keepalive to keep connections warm. Config applied and observed fewer FINs.
traffic-bot: Rolling weight back to normal distribution. Standby pool removed.
incident-bot: Metrics update (02:21 UTC): error_rate now ~0.7% over 1m window. Returning to baseline but will monitor for 30m.
jess_cs: Status page posted: "Mitigated: routing/connection and scaling changes reduced 5xx rates. Full investigation underway; postmortem forthcoming." link: https://status.redwood.io/incidents/2025-06-12-gateway-502s
sara_oncall: Handoff: I'll continue monitoring for 20m, then hand to @sam_sre for overnight watch. Please capture any config diffs for the postmortem. Leaving pager clear for now. :white_check_mark: :coffee:
sam_sre: taking over at 02:35 UTC. I'll collect logs, envoy configs, and cert rotation timestamps for the follow-up.
